SCENE: The courtroom, day
A panelled courtroom with a high bench.
ON SCREEN: Hartley (calm), Mr Halloran (nervous)
EVIDENCE: guest_list: A guest list in a neat hand, with a cook's name beside the first departure.
EVIDENCE: weather_report: A weather report, folded twice, promising rain.
EVIDENCE: weather_report_2: A second weather report from the next town: rain there too.
EVIDENCE: photograph: A photograph of the dark hall.
HARTLEY: Mr Halloran, you were there. Tell the court.
TESTIMONY: Mr Halloran
MR HALLORAN (nervous): I heard the clock strike twelve just before the scream.
MR HALLORAN: The study door was open when I passed it.
MR HALLORAN: The study door was open, I am sure of it.
MR HALLORAN (sweating): I heard the clock strike twelve, I swear it.
MR HALLORAN: The study door was open when I passed it.
END TESTIMONY
PUZZLE: courtroom (testimony)
HARTLEY (calm): The court will note the contradiction.
